title: Have a safe and fun holiday at Fiesta Island!
description:
Make the most of your Fourth of July and summer trips to Fiesta Island! 🎆 ☀️ Please remember:

- Fiesta Island closes at 10 p.m. and any vehicles still on the island after that time may be cited or towed.
- Alcohol is never permitted. No glass, either.
- Burning of non-approved materials is prohibited, and all fires must be contained within City-provided rings.
- No parking where indicated and reckless driving is prohibited and strictly enforced.
- No amplified music.
- Fireworks are strictly prohibited.

Follow all posted regulations, and everyone will have a great time at Fiesta Island. Have a safe and fun holiday!

#FindYourHappySpace
